name: stealthmark-sdk
description: Open-source SDK (Apache-2.0) that detects self-identified AI agents, serves an agent manifest and meters agent traffic: core, Next.js, Express/Fastify and CLI

scripts.build: npm run build -w @stealthmark/core && npm run build -w @stealthmark/next -w @stealthmark/express -w @stealthmark/cli
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @stealthmark/core && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
